text: I would not, at twenty years, be a preaching missionary of abstemiousness and sobriety; and I should let other people do as they would, without formally and sententiously rebuking them for it; but I would be most firmly resolved not to destroy my own faculties and constitution; in complaisance to those who have no regard to their own.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter VII, to his son, London, March 27, Old Style 1747
